note: min_band_confidence gates the temperature-calibrated probability of the predicted band and becomes prediction_confidence; it is a FIXED provisional research/demo value (0.80), not swept or optimized, applied uniformly to all four bands. minor_gate_threshold gates P(minor)=P(0_5)+P(6_11)+P(12_17) and is the legacy minor/adult gate -- NOT a prediction confidence -- chosen on VALIDATION and used only as the extra adult safety guard on the 18plus band.
